# Walkthru

> The launch check for apps built with AI: AI test users try your signup and dashboard in your own browser, plus SEO, AI search readiness and passive security in one ranked report.

Walkthru is for indie developers, small startups and agencies who build with AI coding tools. An Instant Scan needs only a URL. The browser extension lets test users try logged-in pages in the tab you are already signed in to. Every report ends in a fix prompt for your coding agent.

## Product

- [Home](https://trywalkthru.com/): what Walkthru checks and a sample report
- [Pricing](https://trywalkthru.com/pricing): Free, Launch Pack, Pro and Plus
- [Documentation](https://trywalkthru.com/docs): Instant Scan, the extension, test users, the fix prompt and the MCP server
